# A citation of a term that does not exist

`Glossary: gls-tref-unknown-term` `DRAFT`

A glossary citing an entry another glossary does not hold.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `part-ref` is exercised against a type whose parts are headings, where the
document the citation names resolves and the term does not.

## Terms

### Anchor

The address a heading offers, which is what `gls-dupe-two-terms-alike.no-such-term` fails to reach.
